games.title: Sort the recycling
games.hook: Build a small network from pieces and train it to sort cans from bottles. How few pieces will do?
games.alt: Cans and bottles of different sizes on either side of a flat divider, with four items ringed as being in the wrong bin.

games.title: Guide the robot home
games.hook: Set the robot's move strength and carry-over so it reaches its charger within par, without getting stuck or bouncing past.
games.alt: A small robot on a three-dimensional valley, above the charger at the valley floor.

games.title: Photo Finish
games.hook: Save six rare concert moments. Can 97.5% AI accuracy still leave your album incomplete?
games.alt: A contact sheet of concert photos ranked by score, with two gates, and an album below with five of six moments filled.

games.title: Echo the Dance
games.hook: A dancer performs in one city while an echo dances the routine in another. The link carries two numbers a frame. Which two tracks keep the dance?
games.alt: Two dancers side by side, the original on the left and its echo on the right.

games.title: The Wonder Fold
games.hook: A friend says a new paper-plane fold flies 1.5 m farther. Plan the quickest test that backs a real gain at least 80% of the time.
games.alt: An empty playing field with two throwing lanes, a dotted launch line and pace marks.

games.title: Build a review filter
games.hook: Give words points to sort reviews. Why does one little word, "not", cause so much trouble?
games.alt: Four reviews stacked on the zero line between the two sides of the filter, none sorted yet.
